messages.subject: y axis colour
parts:
Hello:

I am trying to change the colour of the axes in a pointrange plot.
However,

opts(axis.line. = theme_segment(colour = "black"))

only seems to change the colour of the x axis. Any suggestions?

Thank you.

Michael
